description: Operational validation catalog for customer-intake.schema.json workloads. The intake schema validates allowed names; this catalog defines how each workload is validated before deployment/service entry.

requiredLicensingOrService: Microsoft Sentinel enabled on the RSOC-created Log Analytics workspace
requiredAccess: Azure Lighthouse delegated roles or RSOC onboarding account bootstrap owner
Microsoft Sentinel Contributor for deployment automation
Log Analytics Contributor where table/workspace configuration is required
validationSignals: Sentinel portal/Defender portal can see workspace

requiredLicensingOrService: Microsoft Defender XDR prerequisites met for the customer tenant
requiredAccess: Tenant Governance relationship active or other approved access path
Security Administrator or scoped Defender role as required
validationSignals: Customer tenant visible in Defender portal/MTO for approved personas
commonBlockers: Customer Conditional Access blocks external/governing access
MTO tenant not added or not visible

requiredLicensingOrService: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Plan 2 or approved equivalent
requiredAccess: Defender portal role or MDE RBAC role for endpoint visibility/configuration
Endpoint deployment owner for onboarding package if customer controls device management
validationSignals: Device tables or Defender XDR signals available
commonBlockers: Customer controls Intune/GPO/SCCM and has not deployed onboarding package
MDE RBAC/device group scope excludes RSOC

requiredLicensingOrService: Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 / Microsoft 365 E5 or approved equivalent
requiredAccess: Defender Email & collaboration permissions or Defender unified RBAC
Exchange-related permissions where policy/quarantine actions are needed
validationSignals: Threat Explorer/advanced hunting access validated where in scope

requiredLicensingOrService: Microsoft Defender for Identity licensed and enabled
validationSignals: Identity alerts/signals visible in Defender/Sentinel path
commonBlockers: Domain controller sensor deployment requires customer maintenance window
AD DS permissions or gMSA not ready
Network connectivity to MDI service blocked

requiredAccess: Security Reader/Operator/Admin or equivalent scoped access
validationSignals: Risky users/sign-ins visible to approved personas
Identity Protection-related detections and workbooks validate
commonBlockers: Conditional Access policy changes require customer approval
Role does not permit required response action

requiredLicensingOrService: Defender for Cloud plans enabled for in-scope subscriptions
requiredAccess: Azure RBAC through Lighthouse or customer-approved scope
Defender for Cloud permissions for posture/security recommendations
validationSignals: Defender for Cloud connector status validated
commonBlockers: Defender for Cloud plan not enabled
Tenant-based vs subscription-based connector duplication risk

requiredLicensingOrService: Approved threat intelligence source or TAXII endpoint
requiredAccess: Sentinel Contributor for TI connector/content deployment
Customer approval for customer-specific intelligence sources
validationSignals: ThreatIntelligenceIndicator table or Defender threat intelligence source populated
TI matching analytics enabled and tested
commonBlockers: Customer-specific vs RSOC-global TI split not approved

requiredLicensingOrService: Approved third-party source and ingestion path
requiredAccess: Connector-specific credentials or customer network/appliance owner
Azure permissions for AMA/DCR/Syslog/CEF/API resources where applicable
